_rationale: Ages 55-64: identical to fixed-growth-no-tax (no income yet). path[n] = 200000 * 1.05^n + 300000. At age 65 (index 10): path ≈ 625778.93, then pension adds 10k/yr reducing net spending to 5k. Growth happens before spending: balance_new = balance * 1.05 - 5000. From age 65 closed-form: (b65 - 100000) * 1.05^n + 100000. 100% probability — balance always positive.
